page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top: "Regna Francorum." with page number "45" at the right. Below the head, one main text column, with marginal notes in the narrow right margin beside the first lines. Catchword "Sub" at the lower right.

main_text.head: Merovingos regno exuc-runt Carolingi.
Explicatio 1.
main_text.p: mutatio regiæ fa-miliæ in Gal-lia,Causa fuit socordia Merovingo-rum, qui, veluti Sardanapali, omnem regni curam in Majores Domus re-jiciebant, à quibus tandem regno plane spoliati sunt, tanquam indigni. Memorabile est, hos Merovingos se-mel tantum in anno, nimirum die Paschatis, corollâ florea redimitos populo conspiciendas se præbuisse in plaustro rustico, quod ad majo-rem contemtum boves trahebant.
main_text.head: Explicatio 2.
main_text.p: Pipinus igitur, cognomine Par-vus, consensu Zachariæ Pontificis Romani Chilpericum stupidum, ultimum ex familia Merovingorum, in Monasterium detrusit, & se Regem Franciæ constituit. Ejus filius fuit Carolus Magnus.

page.notes: The "Sub" at the lower right is the catchword. The marginal note's hyphenation ("fa-miliæ", "Gal-lia") is inferred from the line breaks. "Chilpericum" is copied as printed (the usual form is Childericum). The page number is printed as "45" in the running head. The "Merovingos regno exucrunt Carolingi." line is a title over the passage and is set as level 2.
